digest.component_or_area: MCP HTTP service deployment on AWS
propositions: Rebar MCP HTTP server must be deployed on the AWS box with nginx /mcp/ TLS edge routing to loopback-bound rebar-mcp using static bearer token authentication per client
MCP auto-deploy must use blue-green immutable-release strategy with atomic nginx upstream flip and retire-when-idle, independent of review-bot drain mechanics to avoid operation kills

MCP container must sign certified plan-review and completion-verifier operations under the existing opcert environment (9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65), with enforceable routing via verify.require_environment configuration
Per-client bearer PATs must be provisioned via SSM parameters as code (ssm.tf) with gitignored local credential template and committed-secret guard validation
Copilot, Codex, and Claude clients must be configured with static-bearer HTTP headers pointing to the MCP server endpoint, verified against current official client documentation
User-facing guidance must be updated to require MCP for all rebar operations except local-only workflows, with corrected certified-op wording distinguishing code-review votes from opcert kinds
